name: storefront
prompt: Using the attached photo as the reference, create a clean, professional, straight-on architectural photograph of this one shopfront, in black and white (monochrome, rich tonal range, no colour at all). Keep the shop itself recognisable: the same green fascia board (rendered in grey) with the large OPPO logo and the small text G-88 and TAB HOUSE & REHAN TRADERS LAB, the same glass display wall with tablets and boxes in neat rows, the glass door and the Rehan Traders R-logo poster on the lower door. Fix the framing: the fascia board and logo must be perfectly level and straight, the camera square-on at eye level, vertical lines vertical, no tilt. Remove everything that is not this shop: delete the broken, dirty walls and pillars on the left and right, the neighbouring shops with their displays and signs, the hanging phone-case stands, the people, the jerry can, the loose cables and the STOP AT NOTHING signs above. Replace the sides with plain, clean, softly lit wall so the shopfront stands alone and centred with even margins. Evenly lit, no glare, no dirt, no grain. Do not invent any new text or logos; keep existing sign text spelled exactly as it is.
alt: Shopfront of Rehan Traders, Shop G-88, Ground Floor, Hafeez Center, Lahore
